create_robot_instance: create a Robot instance from a MuJoCo XML model path with sensor and actuator configuration
run_robot_step: run a robot step by applying normalized controls and stepping the simulation forward
get_robot_sensors: get robot sensor data including qpos, qvel, act from simulation or hardware
reset_robot_state: reset the robot to a specified position and velocity while enforcing actuator limits
process_actuator_controls: process actuator controls by remapping normalized values and enforcing position and velocity limits
